🎥🎬: The Ridiculous 6 (2015)

Tommy “White Knife” Stockburn is a tough frontier outlaw raised by a Native American tribe after being abandoned as a child. When a mysterious stranger reveals that he is Tommy’s father, Frank Stockburn, Tommy discovers that he has five half-brothers he never knew existed. But their reunion takes a dangerous turn when Frank is kidnapped by ruthless bandits who demand a fortune for his release.

Determined to save their father, Tommy and his newly discovered brothers set off on a wild journey across the Old West. Each brother brings a different personality and unusual set of skills to the mission, leading to outrageous encounters, ridiculous shootouts, and one disaster after another. As they travel together, the brothers begin to understand what family really means.

With danger closing in and time running out, the unlikely siblings must put aside their differences and work together to rescue Frank. Packed with absurd humour, over-the-top Western action, and unexpected twists, The Ridiculous 6 turns the classic cowboy adventure into a chaotic comedy about brotherhood and second chances.

source_details.synopsis: The Ridiculous 6 is a 2015 American Western action comedy film directed by Frank Coraci and written by Tim Herlihy and Adam Sandler, and starring Sandler, Terry Crews, Jorge Garcia, Taylor Lautner, Rob Schneider, and Luke Wilson. As Happy Madison Productions' first Western film, as well as their first under Netflix, the plot follows six men who discover that they share the same bank-robbing father (Nick Nolte) and thereafter set out to reunite with him. Released worldwide on Netflix as their first original film on December 11, 2015, the film was panned by critics and is one of the few films to receive an approval rating of 0% on Rotten Tomatoes.
